description: The landing says contents encrypt and the service 'never' gets the drive key but does not mention that paths, sizes, tags and activity metadata stay visible; that disclosure exists only on /pricing. A privacy-focused reader would see the landing as overselling.
expected: One-line metadata caveat next to the landing privacy claim, or a link to the pricing data section.
actual: Metadata disclosure only in the pricing 'Private contents.' card.
suggested_fix: Add 'Paths, sizes and tags stay visible' to the landing card with a link.

description: The share page logo mark reads 'ad' while every other page uses 'a/'.
actual: Share error page shows 'ad agent drive'.

description: The share-error page for a link without a key gives only 'Ask the sender'; there is no link to the home page except the small logo, and a title widow ('key') on its own line at desktop. Note a revoked link cannot be told apart from a key-missing link when opened without the key.
expected: A clear secondary link (e.g. 'What is Agent Drive?') and balanced heading wrap.
suggested_fix: Add a home link; use text-wrap: balance on the heading.

description: Visiting /pricing and following to the console logs '[error] Failed to fetch RSC payload for /console/billing. Falling back to browser navigation.' because the Next prefetch of /console/billing is redirected cross-origin to Clerk.
expected: No console errors on public pages.
actual: RSC fetch failure logged (seen in the same session after the pricing page).
suggested_fix: Use prefetch={false} on links to protected routes, or fix the sign-in redirect domain.
